verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops feature explicitly lets users describe a job in plain language and choose whether it runs on a schedule or in response to an event, targeting recurring team work like planning, updates, or doc maintenance (linear-docs-11, linear-docs-36, linear-docs-12, linear-docs-34). This directly matches the story of scheduled/recurring automation for routine work. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Loops reliability, and more detail on schedule configuration granularity.
